Power comes from a 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton gas engine paired with a hydraulic oil cooler that holds oil temperatures steady through continuous running. A canopy, digging bucket and hydraulic thumb clip are part of the package, covering trenching, ditch clearing, rock breaking, light dozing and general landscaping.

excerpt: A 1,150 kg gas excavator with an enclosed cabin, EPA-certified 13.5 hp engine and a 380 mm standard digging bucket.
description:
Rated at 1,150 kg, roughly 2,500 lb, the Terror X sits in the class that passes through a yard gate and still cuts a usable trench. Its enclosed cabin keeps the operator out of the weather on longer jobs, and the boom and inner bucket hoses are routed with protection against knocks.
The EPA-certified 13.5 hp Briggs & Stratton engine is tuned for modest fuel use rather than outright output, which stretches working time per tank. Supplied with a 380 mm standard digging bucket, a tool box, the cabin and a digital manual, it covers digging, drilling, grabbing, ditch cleaning and landscaping work.

excerpt: One-ton Typhon excavator fitted with a canopy and a 380 mm bucket, supplied with a tool box and digital manual.
description:
Trenching between garden beds, clearing ditches, breaking rock, grabbing brush, shifting soil around orchards and parks: the X STORM does full-size excavator work on a much smaller scale. Its footprint is the point, since it tracks and turns where a larger machine would have to stop at the gate.
A 380 mm digging bucket suits most one-ton trenching, and the platform ground clearance keeps the undercarriage clear on rutted ground and spoil piles. The canopy is standard, and a tool box and digital manual come with the machine alongside the bucket.

excerpt: A one-ton canopy excavator with a hydraulic oil cooler, 380 mm bucket and a hydraulic thumb clip included as standard.
description:
Landscapers, growers and contractors working inside fences, hedgerows and other fixed boundaries are the intended audience for this one-ton class machine. The canopy overhead deals with sun, rain and the occasional falling branch, while a hydraulic oil cooler holds system temperature down over a long session.
At 380 mm, or 15 inches, the bucket strikes a middle ground between narrow trenching and moving volume per pass. A hydraulic thumb clip is fitted alongside it for lifting pipe, rock and root balls, and a toolbox and digital manual complete the package.

excerpt: Kubota V1505 diesel, a climate-controlled cabin and retractable tracks on a compact excavator meant for year-round work.
description:
The enclosed cabin with air conditioning and a heater is what changes the job here, since full days in August heat or January cold no longer fall on the operator. Underneath it sits a Kubota V1505 diesel, EPA Tier 4 Final certified, producing 24.8 hp and 92.6 Nm of torque, which is 68.3 lb-ft.
Tracks retract to 1,060 mm for gate and alley access and extend to 1,350 mm for stability. Dig depth reaches 2.75 m with 4.39 m of reach and 22 kN of bucket force, boom swing runs 45 degrees left and 55 degrees right, and ground clearance measures 200 mm. A 500 mm digging bucket, a heavy-duty toolbox and a digital manual are included.

excerpt: A 1.1-ton excavator with boom swing, 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton power and a 0.025 cbm bucket for close-quarters digging.
description:
Boom swing is what separates this 1.1-ton machine from most of its class. The boom pivots off centre, so the bucket can work tight against a wall or a fence line without moving the tracks to reset the angle.
A 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton engine and a double throttle valve hydraulic circuit handle the work. Maximum dig depth is 1,626 mm, about 5.3 feet, with a 0.025 cbm bucket and 7.2 kN of bucket force. The kit covers a 400 mm digging bucket, a hydraulic thumb clip, a protective canopy, a heavy-duty toolbox and a digital operation manual.

excerpt: A 1.3-ton excavator with a 795 mm tail swing radius, 270 mm dozer blade and a 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton XR2100 engine.
description:
The number that matters on this machine is the 795 mm tail swing radius. The rear end stays close to the track line through a rotation, which is what makes digging alongside a wall or fence practical rather than fiddly.
Operating weight is 1.3 tons, dig depth 1,710 mm, and overall machine height 2,270 mm. A 270 mm dozer blade takes care of grading and backfilling, and the 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton XR2100 engine supplies the power. The 0.025 cbm digging bucket, hydraulic thumb clip, canopy, toolbox and digital manual all come with it.

excerpt: A 4,200 lb Kubota D902 excavator with boom swing, retractable tracks, hydraulic thumb and an enclosed AC and heater cabin.
description:
Around 4,200 lb of machine in a footprint of 2,200 mm long, 1,150 mm wide and 2,300 mm high: enough mass to dig properly, little enough to work between orchard rows and inside a walled yard. A Kubota D902 three-cylinder diesel supplies the power, and the cabin is enclosed with air conditioning and heat.
Track width retracts to 1,000 mm and extends to 1,300 mm, while boom swing lets the bucket work off to one side of the machine. Three-way stop valves feed powered attachments such as augers and breakers, and a 415 mm bucket and hydraulic thumb are fitted for trenching, grading, drilling and landscaping.

excerpt: A 1.8-ton swing-boom trench digger powered by a water-cooled Kubota D902 diesel, with a 430 mm bucket and a canopy.
description:
This 1.8-ton STORM runs a Kubota D902, a vertical, water-cooled, three-cylinder four-cycle IDI diesel rated at 11.8 kW, or 15.8 HP. The swing boom gives it reach off the centre line, which matters when digging along a foundation, a fence or a curb.
Bucket width is 430 mm with 0.03 cbm of capacity, and platform ground clearance measures 402 mm for crossing rough ground and spoil. Grabbing, ditch cleaning, rock breaking and small excavations all fall inside its range. It comes with the standard digging bucket, a canopy, a tool box and a digital manual.

excerpt: A 1.05-ton excavator measuring 1,000 mm wide, with an 870 mm tail radius, 1,735 mm dig depth and a hydraulic thumb clip.
description:
At 1,000 mm across and 2,190 mm tall, this 1.05-ton machine is built around access, narrow enough for a garden gate and short enough for a low carport. The tail swings within 870 mm, so it can rotate with a wall close behind it.
A 13.5 HP Briggs & Stratton XR2100 engine drives the hydraulics, dig depth runs to 1,735 mm and ground clearance measures 380 mm. The 0.03 cbm digging bucket, hydraulic thumb clip, canopy, toolbox and digital manual are all included, which covers trenching, tree planting, pond digging and utility work without further outlay.

excerpt: A 3,800 lb Kubota D902 excavator with 18 MPa hydraulics, dual auxiliary circuits and integrated hydraulic oil cooling.
description:
Attachment work is as much the point of this 3,800 lb machine as digging is. The hydraulic circuit runs at 18 MPa, about 2,610 psi, with double-sided auxiliary throttle valves so a powered attachment and the thumb can draw flow at the same time, and oil cooling protects the system on long runs.
Power comes from an EPA-certified Kubota D902 three-cylinder diesel: 15.8 HP at 2,200 rpm, rising to 20.4 HP at 3,600 rpm when breakout force is needed. A 4.76-gallon hydraulic reservoir and a 3.17-gallon fuel tank extend the working session, and the pilot controls run on 1.82 GPM for fine grading and trenching.

excerpt: The 4,000 lb PRO in enclosed-cabin form, with Kubota D902 diesel, offset boom, retractable tracks and climate control.
description:
This is the enclosed-cabin build of the 4,000 lb PRO, with air conditioning and a heater so the seat stays workable in July and in February. The offset boom shifts the digging line to one side of the machine, which is how it gets close to walls, footings and property lines.
An EPA-certified Kubota D902 three-cylinder diesel rates 15.8 HP at 2,200 rpm, with a 20.4 HP ceiling reached at 3,600 rpm. Hydraulics operate at 18 MPa with pilot controls, dual auxiliary circuits and oil cooling, and the tanks hold 3.17 gallons of fuel and 4.76 gallons of hydraulic oil for longer stretches between stops.

excerpt: A 3,800 lb compact excavator built around Kubota D902 diesel power and a hydraulic system set up for powered attachments.
description:
The PRO sits at the working end of Typhon's compact range, a 3,800 lb excavator aimed at contractors, landscapers and property owners who run attachments as often as a bucket. Its Kubota D902 diesel is EPA certified and three-cylinder, rated at 15.8 HP at 2,200 rpm and 20.4 HP at 3,600 rpm.
Working pressure is 18 MPa, roughly 2,610 psi, and a pilot flow of 1.82 GPM keeps joystick response predictable during fine grading. Double-sided auxiliary throttle valves let a breaker or auger run without interrupting the thumb, while a 4.76-gallon hydraulic reservoir and a 3.17-gallon fuel tank cut down on refill stops.

excerpt: A 4,000 lb Kubota-powered excavator with boom swing, retractable tracks, a hydraulic thumb and a climate-controlled cabin.
description:
The Prestige build adds a sealed, climate-controlled cabin to the 4,000 lb PRO chassis and fits a hydraulic thumb from the outset. Rotation is a continuous 360 degrees on wide rubber tracks, and the offset boom keeps digging possible alongside structures and boundary lines.
Its Kubota D902 three-cylinder diesel is EPA certified, rated at 15.8 HP at 2,200 rpm and a maximum 20.4 HP at 3,600 rpm. Hydraulics operate at 18 MPa with pilot controls, two auxiliary circuits and oil cooling, which covers trenching, demolition, grading and attachment work such as breakers and augers.

excerpt: Swing boom of 45 degrees left and 55 right, Kubota D902 diesel power and a heated, air-conditioned cabin on a 4,000 lb machine.
description:
Boom swing on this 4,000 lb excavator runs 45 degrees to the left and 55 degrees to the right, so the operator can dig parallel to a wall or hedge while the tracks stay put. The upper structure turns a continuous 360 degrees, and rubber tracks keep travel stable across rough or finished ground.
The Kubota D902 diesel is EPA certified, rated at 15.8 HP at 2,200 rpm with up to 20.4 HP at 3,600 rpm. A hydraulic system at 18 MPa, pilot-operated controls and dual auxiliary valves let a breaker, auger or grapple run while the thumb stays live, and oil cooling protects the circuit through long days.

excerpt: A 4,000 lb Kubota D902 digger with 2,300 mm dig depth, a 0.03 cbm bucket, boom swing and a hydraulic thumb included.
description:
Four thousand pounds of operating weight, a 2,300 mm digging depth and a 1,711 mm swing radius place this machine between a true micro digger and a full compact excavator. The Kubota D902 fitted to it is a water-cooled three-cylinder diesel rated at 20.4 HP.
Tanks hold 6.1 L of fuel and 17.1 L of hydraulic oil, which keeps refills infrequent across a long day. The 360 mm bucket carries 0.03 cubic metres, digging height matches the 2,300 mm dig depth, and boom swing control handles offset work. Bucket, hydraulic thumb, canopy and digital manual come with the machine.

excerpt: Two-ton Kubota-powered excavator with a factory-fitted climate cabin, 2,060 mm dig depth and a 380 mm precision bucket.
description:
A two-ton excavator with a factory-fitted cabin, air conditioning and heat, which in practice means work carries on in weather that would otherwise end the day. Minimum swing radius is 1,711 mm, and boom swing allows digging offset from the tracks in congested corners.
The Kubota D902 is a three-cylinder, water-cooled diesel rated at 20.4 HP and built to EPA-compliant standards. Digging depth measures 2,060 mm and digging height 2,580 mm, with a 380 mm bucket holding 0.03 cbm. A heavy-duty toolbox and a digital operator manual are supplied alongside the bucket.

excerpt: Two-ton trench digger with Kubota diesel power, an aircon and heater cabin, 380 mm bucket and a hydraulic thumb clip.
description:
Two tons is roughly the point where a compact excavator stops being a garden tool and starts being a small jobsite machine, and this one keeps an enclosed cabin with air conditioning and a heater rather than a bare canopy. A Kubota diesel drives it, sized for steady output and straightforward maintenance.
The 380 mm bucket holds 0.03 cbm, which suits trenching for pipe and cable as much as general soil moving in parks, orchards and yards. A hydraulic thumb clip, tool box and digital manual are part of the package alongside the bucket and the cabin.

excerpt: A two-ton Kubota mini excavator with an enclosed heated and air-conditioned cabin and a 0.03 cbm digging bucket.
description:
Garden redesigns, orchard drainage, park repairs and farm tracks are the kind of small and medium projects this two-ton machine was set up for. It carries an enclosed cabin with air conditioning and a heater instead of a canopy, and a Kubota diesel supplies power with maintenance kept simple.
Digging, drilling, grabbing, bulldozing, ditch cleaning and rock breaking all sit within its range, and the 380 mm bucket holds 0.03 cbm. Included with the machine are the standard digging bucket, a hydraulic thumb clip, a tool box, the aircon and heater cabin, and a digital manual.

excerpt: A 4,000 lb Kubota D902 excavator in green, with a 450 mm bucket, 20.5 L hydraulic tank and a hydraulic thumb clip.
description:
The green-painted XX carries 4,000 lb of operating weight, around 1.8 tons, on an EPA-certified Kubota D902 diesel built to Tier 4 standards. Tank capacities are 20.5 L for hydraulic oil and 13.5 L for fuel, which is what allows long uninterrupted stretches of digging.
Its 450 mm bucket holds 0.025 cbm, a width that trenches cleanly while still moving reasonable volume per pass. Stainless steel and reinforced polymer are used on components exposed to corrosion, and a hydraulic thumb clip is included for handling pipe, boulders and debris. Thermal management is set up for sustained sessions.

excerpt: A 2.5-ton excavator with a 25.1 HP Kubota D1105 diesel, 2,045 mm dig depth, boom swing and a 450 mm digging bucket.
description:
At 2.5 tons this is the larger end of the Typhon compact range, though a minimum swing radius of 1,955 mm still lets it turn inside a fenced yard or between orchard rows. Digging depth reaches 2,045 mm.
The engine is a water-cooled Kubota D1105 producing 25.1 HP, with maximum torque of 71.4 Nm, or 52.7 lb-ft, at 2,200 rpm. That figure is the useful one when breaking hard ground. Boom swing handles offset work, and a 450 mm digging bucket, a hydraulic thumb clip, a toolbox and a digital manual come with the machine.

excerpt: A Kubota D1105 excavator with retractable tracks, a swing boom and a sealed cabin that is heated and air conditioned.
description:
The Prestige version seals the operator into a cabin that is both heated and air conditioned, measuring 900 mm across inside, and adds retractable tracks for passing through a gateway before widening out to dig. A swing boom extends reach past the centre line of the machine.
Its Kubota D1105 is a vertical, water-cooled, four-cycle diesel producing 25.1 HP at 3,000 rpm and 19 HP at 2,200 rpm, with peak torque of 71.4 Nm, or 52.7 lb-ft, at 2,200 rpm. Digging, drilling, trenching, grading, light bulldozing and landscaping are all within scope, with full hydraulic control across the functions.

excerpt: One-ton excavator measuring 2,170 by 940 by 2,200 mm, with Briggs & Stratton gas power, an oil cooler and a thumb clip.
description:
Measuring 2,170 by 940 by 2,200 mm, the Tyrant X fits through a standard backyard gate and down the kind of narrow pathway that rules out larger equipment. At a one-ton operating weight it also loads onto a small trailer, which keeps moving it between sites simple.
A 13.5HP Briggs & Stratton gasoline engine handles the power side, with consistent starting and modest fuel use. A built-in hydraulic oil cooler holds system temperatures down in hot climates and over long runs. The hydraulic thumb clip is fitted as standard, so gripping logs, rock and heavy debris needs no added attachment.

excerpt: A 10,000 lb two-post lift with an overhead beam, direct-drive hydraulics without chains, and automatic arm restraints.
description:
Rated to 10,000 lb, this two-post lift covers cars, SUVs and light-duty trucks in a commercial bay or a well-equipped home garage. The overhead beam design routes equalization cables and hydraulic lines above the vehicle rather than across the floor, leaving the bay clear for creepers, jacks and tool carts.
A direct-drive hydraulic system works without chains, and dual-synchro equalization keeps both posts rising together. Front arms are two-stage and rear arms three-stage to suit different wheelbases, with low-profile pads for sports cars. Automatic arm restraints, multiple lock positions and a single-point safety release cover the safety side, on reinforced steel with a powder-coated finish.

excerpt: Three-burner Weber gas grill with a 68 x 48 cm cooking area, GBS cast iron grates, lid thermometer and storage cabinet.
description:
Three stainless steel burners sit under a 68 by 48 cm primary cooking area, on cast iron grates finished in porcelain enamel and cut for the Gourmet BBQ System inserts, which hold heat well. The porcelain-enamelled lid carries a built-in thermometer, and electronic ignition lights the burners.
Side tables give room to work and carry hooks for tools, while the cart below encloses a storage cabinet behind a door. A warming rack holds finished food clear of the grates. The grill runs on butane or propane with a regulator and hose supplied, measures 157 cm wide by 78 cm deep and 160 cm tall with the lid open, and weighs about 59 kg.

excerpt: Three-burner 14.4 kW Weber with a Sear Zone Boost mode, a Weber Works side platform and a built-in digital thermometer.
description:
Three stainless steel burners produce 14.4 kW across a 68 by 48 cm cooking area, and a dedicated Sear Zone with Boost mode brings one section up to searing heat for steaks and chops. Its grates are cast iron under porcelain enamel, cut for Weber Crafted GBS inserts; the frame kit for those is not included.
The right-hand stainless steel side table forms a Weber Works platform with a digital thermometer built in, while the left table folds down when space is short. A fixed warming rack, a metal lid handle, and a regulator and hose for butane or propane complete it. Dimensions run 156 cm wide, 69 cm deep and 122 cm high, at 61 kg.

excerpt: A black Genesis gas grill carrying Weber's Infinity ignition and the cooking system that reworked the series after 37 years.
description:
Weber's Genesis line dates to 1985, and the current generation is the first full redesign of the series in 37 years. This black-finish model belongs to that generation and is built on the cooking system Weber has refined across more than 65 years of making grills.
The Infinity ignition system is the clearest change. It was engineered over several years of development to light on the first attempt rather than asking for a second try on a cold morning. The rest of the design follows the same brief, with components chosen for straightforward handling and predictable results across the cooking surface.

excerpt: A black-finish Genesis gas grill built on Weber's redesigned cooking system and the reliable Infinity ignition.
description:
Part of the Genesis generation Weber introduced as the first major redesign of the series since 1985, this model wears a black finish over the current cooking system. The layout reflects what Weber took from decades of feedback from people who grill often.
Ignition is handled by the Infinity system, developed specifically to remove the failed light from the routine. The burners and the rest of the cooking system are arranged for steady heat and simple operation rather than novelty, which has been the Genesis argument since the original arrived.

excerpt: Four-burner Weber with an 86 x 48 cm cooking area, enamelled cast iron GBS grates, twin side tables and a closed cabinet.
description:
Four stainless steel burners and an 86 by 48 cm primary cooking area make this the grill for a long guest list. Cast iron grates in porcelain enamel sit over the burners, cut for Gourmet BBQ System inserts, and a thermometer is set into the enamelled lid.
Both side tables carry utensil hooks, the cabinet below closes with a front-opening door, and the warming rack tucks away when the full grate is needed. The Weber Works platform accepts compatible modular accessories, and the grill is iGrill 3 ready, though the device itself is not included. It runs on butane or propane with a regulator and hose supplied, measures 174 cm wide by 78 cm deep and 160 cm tall with the lid open, and weighs about 64 kg.

excerpt: Hot water and central heating handled by one wall-mounted gas unit, sized for a house with a moderate heating load.
description:
The NCB-190/060H splits its work between two loads: 160,000 BTU on the domestic hot water side and 60,000 BTU for space heating. Two stainless steel heat exchangers carry that work, with a 15:1 turndown on hot water and up to 10:1 on heating, so the burner can run low through mild weather.
Zoning connections for three pumps or three zone valves are wired in from the factory, and the control panel uses an LCD display, a quick dial, and a guided setup routine. Venting is 2-inch PVC out to 65 feet or 3-inch out to 150 feet, and the gas train converts between natural gas and propane in the field at elevations up to 10,100 feet. Coverage runs one year on labor, five on parts, and ten on the heat exchanger.

excerpt: Combi-boiler rated at 160,000 BTU for hot water and 80,000 BTU for heating, all from a single wall-mounted cabinet.
description:
Heating output here is 80,000 BTU, paired with 160,000 BTU on the domestic hot water side, which places this model a step above the 060H in the same NCB-H family. Dual stainless steel heat exchangers handle both duties, and the burner modulates 15:1 for hot water and as far as 10:1 for heating.
Powered connections for three zone pumps or three zone valves sit in the cabinet, joined by an LCD control with a quick dial wheel and a setup wizard. The unit vents through 2-inch pipe up to 65 feet or 3-inch up to 150 feet, and converts between natural gas and propane on site at altitudes to 10,100 feet. Limited warranty: one year labor, five years parts, ten years heat exchanger.

excerpt: A natural gas combi rated 199,900 BTU for domestic hot water and 110,000 BTU for space heating, with three zones wired in.
description:
Domestic hot water runs to 199,900 BTU on this unit while the heating side is rated 110,000 BTU, which suits a house with more radiation to feed than the smaller NCB models can cover. Stainless steel dual heat exchangers do the work, with 15:1 turndown on hot water and up to 10:1 on heating.
The cabinet includes powered connections for three zone pumps or three zone valves, an LCD display with a quick dial, and a setup wizard for commissioning. Cascading covers up to 15 units and common venting up to 7. Vent runs are 2-inch to 65 feet or 3-inch to 150 feet. Coverage is one year labor, five years parts, and ten years on the heat exchanger.

excerpt: Top of the NCB-H range, pairing 199,900 BTU of hot water output with 130,000 BTU dedicated to space heating.
description:
Space heating capacity reaches 130,000 BTU on this model, with domestic hot water rated at 199,900 BTU from the same natural gas cabinet. It carries the largest heating output in the NCB-H series, aimed at houses where the boiler load rather than the shower load sets the size.
Two stainless steel heat exchangers separate the duties, and the burner turns down 15:1 on hot water and as far as 10:1 on heating. Three zone pumps or three zone valves land on built-in powered terminals. Field conversion between natural gas and propane is supported up to 10,100 feet, and venting runs 2-inch to 65 feet or 3-inch to 150 feet. Warranty is one year labor, five years parts, ten years heat exchanger.

excerpt: A wall-hung condensing fire tube boiler rated at 175,000 BTU, set up for natural gas or propane with conversion orifices supplied.
description:
Rated at 175,000 BTU, this heat-only boiler is built around a fire tube heat exchanger in patented stainless steel, shaped to cut down on the high-stress welds common to other designs. A dual venturi system manages combustion and widens the turndown range.
The cabinet hangs on a wall rather than standing on the floor, which frees up room in a mechanical space, and powered connections for three zone valves or three zone pumps are already in place. Commissioning runs through a text display and a quick dial with a guided wizard. Orifice conversion kits for propane and high-altitude natural gas ship with the boiler. Venting is 2-inch PVC to 65 feet or 3-inch to 150 feet. Warranty covers one year labor, five years parts, ten years heat exchanger.

excerpt: Condensing fire tube boiler putting out 199,900 BTU, with a patented stainless steel heat exchanger in a wall-hung cabinet.
description:
At 199,900 BTU, this is the larger of the two residential NFB-H boilers. Its fire tube exchanger, patented and made of stainless steel, is shaped to avoid the concentrated weld stress that shortens the life of other exchangers, and a dual venturi arrangement holds combustion steady across the turndown range.
Controls use a text display with a quick dial wheel and a startup wizard. Three zone valves or three zone pumps wire straight into built-in powered terminals. Conversion orifices for liquid propane and high-altitude natural gas are supplied. Venting is 2-inch PVC to 65 feet, or 3-inch to 150 feet. In residential use the limited warranty runs one year labor, five years parts, and ten years on the heat exchanger.

excerpt: Commercial condensing fire tube boiler rated 301,000 BTU, with a 7-inch color display and building automation communication.
description:
Sized for commercial work at 301,000 BTU, this boiler carries the same fire tube exchanger used across the NFB line, patented and built in stainless steel, a design meant to keep pressure off high-stress welds. A dual venturi system sharpens combustion control and widens the turndown range, and maximum operating pressure is 160 PSI.
Operation and troubleshooting run through a 7-inch color display, and the boiler reports to a building automation system over a BAS connection. Pipe connections at both top and bottom let it mount on a wall or sit on the floor. An orifice and conversion kit for natural gas to liquid propane are included. The limited warranty covers the heat exchanger for ten years, parts for three, and labor for one.

excerpt: The largest boiler in the NFB-C commercial line at 399,000 BTU, rated to 160 PSI and ready for BAS integration.
description:
Rated at 399,000 BTU, this sits at the high end of the NFB-C commercial range. The stainless steel fire tube heat exchanger is patented and built to keep stress off the welds, while a dual venturi system tightens combustion control and extends the turndown range. Maximum operating pressure is 160 PSI.
A 7-inch color display handles setup, diagnostics, and day-to-day operation, and BAS communication is supported for buildings with central controls. Top and bottom pipe connections suit either a floor-standing or wall-hung installation, and an orifice and conversion kit for liquid propane come in the box. Warranty terms are ten years on the heat exchanger, three years on parts, one year on labor.

excerpt: Condensing gas tankless heater rated 120,000 BTU, venting in 2-inch PVC and mounting on a wall bracket that ships with it.
description:
Rated at 120,000 BTU, this condensing tankless unit pulls extra heat out of the exhaust before it leaves the cabinet, which drops flue temperatures far enough to allow SCH 40 2-inch venting out to 75 feet. Two stainless steel heat exchangers handle the transfer, and NOx emissions are held to 20 ppm.
A half-inch gas line will feed it at runs up to 24 feet, and the gas system converts in the field. Controls are the EZNav multi-line panel with a built-in HotButton. Up to 32 units cascade together and up to 12 share a common vent. The box holds a wall mounting bracket, four tapping screws and anchors, two vent terminators, and four wall flanges. Residential warranty: one year labor, three years parts, five years heat exchanger.

excerpt: A 150,000 BTU condensing tankless water heater from the A2 series, packed with a gas conversion kit and vent terminations.
description:
This A2 model is rated at 150,000 BTU and carries a recirculating pump, which puts it in homes where the wait for hot water at a distant fixture is the complaint. Condensing operation keeps flue temperatures low enough for SCH 40 2-inch venting up to 75 feet, and emissions sit at 20 ppm NOx.
Dual stainless steel heat exchangers do the heating. A half-inch gas pipe covers runs to 24 feet, and the gas system converts in the field. Controls are the EZNav multi-line panel with a HotButton. Packed alongside the heater: a conversion kit, a wall mounting bracket, four tapping screws and anchors, two 2-inch vent termination caps, and four 2-inch wall flanges. Residential warranty runs one year labor, five years parts, fifteen years heat exchanger.

excerpt: Wall-mounted condensing tankless heater rated at 150,000 BTU, able to cascade with up to 32 units for larger hot water loads.
description:
The S2 version of the 180 puts out 150,000 BTU and uses the same condensing design, capturing heat that a conventional water heater sends up the flue. Cooler exhaust means SCH 40 2-inch venting is acceptable out to 75 feet, which usually makes the vent run cheaper than metal pipe.
Inside are dual stainless steel heat exchangers, with NOx held at 20 ppm and a gas system that converts in the field. A half-inch gas line reaches 24 feet. As many as 32 units cascade and 12 can common vent, so the same heater suits a single house or a bank feeding a larger building. A mounting bracket, four screws and anchors, two vent terminators, and four wall flanges are included.

excerpt: Condensing tankless water heater rated 180,000 BTU, supplied with a conversion kit, mounting bracket, and vent terminations.
description:
Output here is 180,000 BTU, a step up from the 180 series for households drawing on several fixtures at once. Condensing operation recovers heat that a standard water heater loses through the flue, and the lower exhaust temperature allows SCH 40 2-inch venting out to 75 feet.
Two stainless steel heat exchangers carry the load, NOx stays at 20 ppm, and a half-inch gas pipe will serve runs to 24 feet. The EZNav multi-line panel and a built-in HotButton handle control. Up to 32 units cascade and up to 12 common vent. In the carton: conversion kit, wall mounting bracket, four tapping screws and anchors, two 2-inch vent termination caps, four 2-inch wall flanges. Residential warranty is one year labor, five years parts, fifteen years heat exchanger.

excerpt: An 180,000 BTU condensing tankless unit with EZNav controls, field gas conversion, and low-NOx operation at 20 ppm.
description:
Rated 180,000 BTU, the 210S2 uses condensing heat recovery to pull usable energy from exhaust that a tank heater would vent away. Flue temperatures come down far enough to run SCH 40 2-inch pipe up to 75 feet, which simplifies the vent path in a retrofit.
Dual stainless steel heat exchangers, 20 ppm NOx, and a field-convertible gas system are standard, and a half-inch gas line will supply it at distances up to 24 feet. The EZNav multi-line panel with HotButton handles setup and operation. Cascading covers up to 32 units, common venting up to 12. Packed with the heater are a wall bracket, four tapping screws and anchors, two vent terminators, and four wall flanges.

excerpt: The largest A2 tankless in the range at 199,000 BTU, built with dual stainless heat exchangers and a recirculating pump.
description:
At 199,000 BTU, this sits at the top of the A2 tankless line, and it carries a recirculating pump for homes where hot water has a long way to travel. Condensing heat recovery gives it an energy factor above what a storage tank or a non-condensing tankless heater reaches.
Dual stainless steel heat exchangers carry the load. Because the exhaust runs cool, PVC venting is acceptable, which keeps material costs and installation time down compared with a metal vent. A half-inch gas pipe feeds it at runs up to 24 feet, and the gas system converts in the field between fuels. Natural gas, interior mounting.

excerpt: A 199,000 BTU condensing tankless heater for interior installation, vented in 2-inch SCH 40 pipe out to 75 feet.
description:
This S2 model tops the series at 199,000 BTU and runs on natural gas. The condensing design keeps pulling energy out of the flue gas after combustion is done, so less heat leaves through the vent than with a storage tank or a non-condensing tankless heater.
Because the exhaust leaves cool, venting is SCH 40 2-inch pipe rather than metal, which usually cuts both the material bill and the labor hours. Dual stainless steel heat exchangers, 20 ppm NOx, and a field-convertible gas system are part of the package, and a half-inch gas line will serve runs as long as 24 feet. Built for interior mounting.

excerpt: A rolling low-rise lift rated to 6,000 pounds that collapses to four inches and moves between bays on UHMW rollers.
description:
Rated at 6,000 pounds, the LR-60P is meant to move. High-density UHMW rollers and an included tow handle let one person reposition it between service bays, and the frame collapses to four inches so it slides under vehicles with very little ground clearance.
Power comes from an electric-hydraulic unit. Multi-position safety locks hold the platform at working height, and a single-point release drops both locks together for a controlled descent. Rubber lifting blocks are included to protect undercarriage contact points, and a dropped crossbar opens up room underneath. The frame is heavy-duty steel channel. Capacity suits cars, SUVs, and light-duty trucks.

excerpt: Compact electric forklift rated to 1,500 kg, running on a 60V lithium pack that charges in six hours for ten hours of work.
description:
Rated lifting weight is 1,500 kg at a 500 mm load center, and the mast reaches 4,500 mm in three stages of 1,600 mm, 3,000 mm, and 4,500 mm. Free lift of 1,400 mm keeps the mast down where ceilings are low. The truck itself weighs 2,400 kg on a 1,580 mm wheelbase.
Power is a 60V 260Ah lithium battery that takes six hours on the charger for roughly ten hours of operation, and it plugs into any 110V point using the supplied charger. The body measures 2,410 mm long excluding the forks and 1,220 mm wide, with a minimum turning radius of 2,210 mm and lateral movement for tight aisles. Steering is hydraulic and the tires are solid rubber.

excerpt: Electric forklift with a 1,500 kg rated capacity and a 4.5 m three-stage mast, sized for indoor work under low ceilings.
description:
This VIGOR 1.5 lifts a rated 1,500 kg at a 500 mm load center and reaches 4.5 m through a three-stage mast built in 1.5 m sections. Free lift measures 1,400 mm, which matters when a ceiling will not allow the mast to extend early in the lift. Truck weight is 2,200 kg.
A 60V 140Ah battery supplies the drive and hydraulics, and the included charger works from a standard 110V outlet. The wheelbase measures 1,550 mm, the body runs 2,330 mm long without the forks and 1,200 mm wide, and the minimum turning radius is 2,250 mm. Lateral movement helps in narrow aisles. Steering is hydraulic, on solid rubber tires.

excerpt: A 4,000 lb rubber-track mini excavator on an EPA-certified Kubota D902 diesel, with a hydraulic thumb clip included.
description:
The LUX runs a Kubota D902 diesel certified to EPA standards, mounted in a 4,000 lb machine on rubber tracks. Its size is the point: it fits through openings that stop a full-size excavator, which is what makes it usable indoors and on sites with restricted access.
A hydraulic thumb clip comes with the machine, extending what the bucket can hold to pipe, rock, and loose debris. Orchard work is a common use, from planting and fertilizer application to weeding and digging between rows. Cooling is engineered to shed heat through long sessions rather than short bursts, and the structural parts are built for the loads that come with steady work.

excerpt: Mini excavator weighing 4,000 lbs with a Tier 4 Kubota diesel, an 18.9 L hydraulic reservoir, and a thumb clip included.
description:
Operating weight is 4,000 lbs, or 1.8 tons, on a Kubota engine that meets EPA Tier 4. The fuel tank holds 7.3 liters and the hydraulic oil reservoir 18.9 liters, a generous reserve for a machine this size that helps keep oil temperatures in range through long sessions.
A hydraulic thumb clip is included for gripping boulders, pipe, and debris, and critical components use stainless steel to resist corrosion. The machine fits through a standard doorway, which puts basement digs, interior renovations, and elevator-accessible sites within reach. Its scale also suits orchard and vineyard work such as root pruning, irrigation trenching, and fertilizer injection.

excerpt: A 1,800 lb mini skid steer powered by a 21 hp Honda GX630, arriving with a digging bucket and a tool box.
description:
The STOMP is a small loader built around a Honda GX630 making 21 hp, with peak torque of 48.3 Nm at 2,500 rpm through a hydraulic drive. The compact frame is what lets it work in gardens, orchards, parks, and other spaces a full-size skid steer cannot enter.
Typical jobs include digging, grading, ditch cleaning, rock breaking, small excavation, and general landscaping. The controls are simple enough for an operator who has not run one before. It arrives with a standard digging skid-steer bucket, a tool box, and a digital manual covering operation and maintenance.

excerpt: A 4,000 lb trench digger with a 20.4 hp Kubota D902, boom swing, canopy, and retractable tracks for tight access.
description:
Power is a Kubota D902, a vertical water-cooled three-cylinder four-cycle IDI diesel rated 20.4 hp at 3,600 rpm, in a machine weighing 4,000 lbs. Retractable tracks narrow the stance for getting through gates and doorways, then widen for stability once there is room to work.
The swing boom and full hydraulic control cover digging, trenching, drilling, grabbing, grading, rock breaking, and landscaping. The bucket is 415 mm wide and the tracks run 230 mm for added traction. A two-way relief valve on the rotary motor doubles as a brake valve, protecting the motor from pressure spikes on sudden stops. A canopy covers the operator station.

excerpt: Portable gas pizza oven that takes 14-inch pizzas to 500C and turns out a Neapolitan-style bake in about a minute.
description:
Second-generation Koda, sized for 14-inch pizzas and capable of 500C, hot enough to finish a Neapolitan-style base in around 60 seconds. The burner uses G2 Gas Technology with a patent-pending tapered flame, which spreads heat more evenly across the stone and gives finer control at the dial.
The baking stone is 50 percent thicker than the one in the Koda 12 and reheats about 20 percent faster, which matters when pizzas go in back to back. At 16 kg it stays light enough to carry out to a table and pack away afterward. It runs on propane and comes with a hose and regulator for clip-on canisters. Choose Foundry Black or Slate Blue.

excerpt: The wider Koda 2, with a stone measuring 21 inches across the front and a digital temperature hub in the box.
description:
The Pro is the larger member of the second-generation Koda family, with more than 18 inches of cooking area and a stone that measures 21 inches across the front and 18 inches at the rear. That extra width leaves room for bigger pizzas as well as pans and cast iron.
Heat comes from G2 Gas Technology, a tapered flame burner that evens out stone temperature and brings it back up quickly between bakes. The Ooni Connect Digital Temperature Hub is included, so stone temperature can be tracked rather than guessed. Top temperature is 500C, quick enough for a pizza in roughly 60 seconds. Two finishes are offered, Foundry Black and Slate Blue.

excerpt: Pit-style low-rise lift rated to 9,000 pounds, with an open center that leaves the undercarriage clear for service.
description:
A 9,000 lb capacity puts light trucks and SUVs within range, and the open-center pit design leaves the middle of the vehicle clear, so oil changes, wheel work, and general underbody service happen without a frame in the way. Low-stance cars load without trouble as well.
The upper platform is reinforced for inboard loading, and a dual-pump power unit with a built-in proportioning valve keeps both sides moving together. It drops into an existing fast-lube pit to turn it into a full wheel-service bay, and a flush-mount installation sets it level with the floor. Extended approach ramps are available for longer or lower vehicles.

excerpt: ALI Certified two-post lift rated to 10,000 pounds, with Double S columns and a choice of symmetric or asymmetric setup.
description:
This above-ground two-post lift is ALI Certified and rated for 10,000 pounds, which covers cars, SUVs, and light-duty trucks. The Double S column profile adds structural strength where the carriages travel, and the columns can be set symmetric or asymmetric depending on how vehicles need to sit between them.
Front arms are three-stage and rear arms two-stage, and overall height is selectable at 11 ft 7-7/8 in or 11 ft 3-7/8 in to suit the ceiling. MET Laboratories has certified the ALLY Hydraulic AL2850 power unit to US and Canadian electrical standards. Padded carriages and rubber column guards protect paint, and a single point lock release simplifies lowering.

excerpt: Overhead two-post lift certified by ALI at 12,000 pounds, spaced 132 inches between columns for wide vehicles.
description:
Rated at 12,000 pounds and ALI Certified, this overhead two-post lift is built for shops that see long-wheelbase trucks alongside ordinary passenger cars. Column spacing is 132 inches between symmetrical columns with 108 inches of drive-through clearance, so wide vehicles fit between the posts.
Three-stage arms front and rear adapt to different vehicle sizes, and overall height adjusts to match the building. The ALLY Hydraulic AL3500 power unit meets US and Canadian electrical standards and runs cooler under load. A truck adapter set and mounting hardware are included. Warranty is five years structural and two years on the hydraulic power system.

excerpt: Seven-piece outdoor dining set in slate grey, built from recycled-plastic lumber that never needs paint or sealant.
description:
The set comprises a 37-inch by 72-inch farmhouse dining table, four side chairs, and two arm chairs, all in slate grey. Everything is made from genuine POLYWOOD lumber, a blend of recycled plastics that includes landfill- and ocean-bound material.
The HDPE frames will not crack, peel, chip, or splinter, and they hold up through hot sun, snowy winters, and coastal wind without painting, staining, or waterproofing. Cleaning takes soapy water and a soft-bristle brush. Hardware is marine grade and the furniture is made in the USA. Coverage is a 20-year limited residential warranty and a 3-year limited commercial warranty.

excerpt: Dual-fuel inverter generator making 3,500 starting watts, with electric start, carbon monoxide shutoff, and a parallel port.
description:
Output is 3,500 starting watts and 3,000 running watts, delivered through pure sine wave inverter technology, so laptops, phones, and televisions can be plugged in alongside tools. The enclosure is built around quiet operation, which counts at a campsite or beside a house overnight.
CO SECURE monitoring shuts the engine down if carbon monoxide reaches a dangerous level. Starting is electric and a digital display reports what the unit is doing. Outlets are two 120V 5-20R, one 120V L5-30R twist lock, and one 12VDC, and a parallel port lets two of these run together for double the output. An oil funnel, a 30-amp RV adapter, a spark plug wrench, a screwdriver, and a DC cable are packed in the box.

excerpt: Inverter generator on a 212cc engine, rated at 56 dBA and good for up to 11 hours at a quarter load.
description:
A 212cc Predator engine drives this inverter generator to 3,500 maximum starting watts and 3,000 maximum running watts. The output is pure sine wave, which is what makes it suitable for phones, laptops, and televisions rather than only lights and power tools.
The 2.3-gallon tank carries it up to 11 hours at 25 percent load, enough for an overnight run at an RV site without a refuel. Inside the SUPER QUIET enclosure it measures 56 dBA, roughly the level of a quiet conversation. CO SECURE shuts the unit down automatically if carbon monoxide builds to a dangerous level. Smooth-rolling wheels handle moving it, and an RV adapter is included.

excerpt: Compact 2,000 lb skid steer loader on a Briggs & Stratton gas engine of 23.5 hp, driving all four wheels hydraulically, bucket supplied.
description:
A Briggs & Stratton gas engine rated at 23.5 hp drives this 2,000 lb machine, hydraulics turning all four wheels, with peak torque of 50 Nm at 3,000 rpm. Its footprint suits yards, gardens, orchards and parks, and any site where a full-size loader has nowhere to turn around.
Work it takes on includes rock breaking, ditch cleaning, dozing, grabbing, drilling, digging and general landscaping. Supplied with it are a skid-steer digging bucket of standard pattern, a tool box and a manual in digital form. The engine meets EPA requirements.

excerpt: Gas mini skid steer of 35 hp, only 1,065 mm across, rated to lift 380 kg and sized to work through gates and doorways.
description:
The 508 runs a RATO R999 gasoline engine of 35 hp with OHV valve train, weighs 1,350 kg and is rated to lift 380 kg. Measuring 1,065 mm across, it passes gaps that stop larger machines; transport dimensions are 2,700 by 1,065 by 1,940 mm.
Radial lift reaches 3,050 mm. Unloading height tops out at 2,150 mm, dump reach is 560 mm, and the bucket tips 33 degrees at ground level and 45 degrees at full height. Travel speed is 10 km/h, bucket width is 1,010 mm, and the mounting plate accepts attachments for construction, farm and landscaping work.

excerpt: Mini excavator of 800 kg on a Briggs & Stratton EPA engine, supplied with a canopy roof and a digging bucket of standard pattern.
description:
At 800 kg, this 0.8 ton class machine suits garden plots, farmland, municipal jobs and work in parks or playgrounds, where access tends to be as much of a constraint as the digging. A Briggs & Stratton EPA engine provides the power, and the excavator carries CE certification.
Its layout is deliberately plain, which keeps routine maintenance within reach of whoever runs it. Between them the boom and bucket handle rock breaking, ditch work, dozing, drilling, grabbing and trenching. A canopy roof shelters the seat, and a digging bucket comes with the machine.

excerpt: Hybrid gas and pellet grill: five burners at 45,000 BTU, 8 mm stainless grids, an infrared side burner and rotisserie kit, in matte black.
description:
Wood pellets and gas feed one cookbox here, covering an afternoon of slow smoke and an evening of fast, hot cooking on the same machine. Five Dual-Tube burners in stainless steel rate 45,000 BTU together, under a main grate of 3,677 sq cm that reaches 5,032 sq cm with the stainless rack above.
The 8 mm stainless rods bank enough heat to mark a full load without stalling. Fat lands on full-coverage Flav-R-Wave panels rather than the tubes below, an infrared side burner at 10,000 BTU handles the finishing sear, and a rear burner at 15,000 BTU turns the rotisserie supplied with it. Sensi-Touch Linear-Flow valves, a Therma-Cast aluminum cookbox, drop-down stainless shelves and blue LED knobs finish the matte black build.

excerpt: Compact built-in gas grill on four Dual-Tube burners rated at 40,000 BTU, with reversible cast iron grates and a matte black face.
description:
Made to drop into an island or a masonry surround, this compact four-burner shows only its matte black face and front controls once installed.
Four Dual-Tube burners in stainless steel rate 40,000 BTU together, spread beneath a main grate of 2,865 sq cm. The cast iron grids are reversible: narrow bars on one face for searing, a grooved profile on the other that keeps juices under the food. A stainless Flav-R-Wave shield turns fat to smoke before it can reach the tubes, and Sure-Lite electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves take care of lighting and heat.

excerpt: Four-burner cart grill at 40,000 BTU, with a side burner for pans, reversible cast iron grates and an enclosed cabinet base.
description:
The four Dual-Tube burners in this cart rate 40,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 2,968 sq cm. That leaves room to keep a hot zone and a holding zone going at once for a mixed load of burgers, chicken and vegetables.
Cast iron grids flip over: narrow bars for searing, a grooved face for basting. Fat coming off the food strikes stainless Flav-R-Wave panels rather than the tubes, which keeps flare-ups down. A side burner rated at 10,000 BTU takes pans, Sure-Lite ignition and Linear-Flow valves set the heat, and the cabinet base hides the tank behind doors with a drop-down shelf on each side.

excerpt: Four-burner gas grill carrying a rear burner of 15,000 BTU with spit kit, a side burner, and cast iron grates that reverse.
description:
Rotisserie is what marks this four-burner out from the rest of the cart range: a rear burner of 15,000 BTU and the spit kit arrive together, ready for whole birds and boned joints.
Its four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together, under a main grate of 2,865 sq cm that reaches 4,155 sq cm once the warming rack is counted. Cast iron grids reverse between a searing face and a basting face, the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield catches fat short of the tubes, and a side burner at 10,000 BTU deals with sauces. Sure-Lite ignition and Linear-Flow valves control the heat.

excerpt: Built-in four-burner in matte black, rated at 40,000 BTU, with reversible cast iron grates and a rear infrared burner for spit roasting.
description:
This four-burner is built for a counter cut-out rather than a cart, presenting a matte black lid and control panel to the rest of the outdoor kitchen. At the back of the cookbox an infrared burner adds spit roasting.
The four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 2,865 sq cm. Cast iron grids reverse between a searing face and a grooved face that holds juices against the food, and a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield stands between flame and grate so fat becomes smoke rather than flare-up.

excerpt: Gas and pellet hybrid: four burners at 40,000 BTU, a main grate of 444 sq in, an infrared side burner and a rotisserie kit.
description:
Pellets and gas run in one cookbox, so a brisket can sit in wood smoke through the afternoon and a steak can meet the 10,000 BTU searing burner, infrared and set to one side, that same evening.
Four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together for ordinary grilling nights, over a main grate of 444 sq in that reaches 644 sq in with the rack. The heavy grids keep their heat through a full load, full-coverage Flav-R-Wave panels in stainless take the fat, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU drives the rotisserie supplied. Sensi-Touch Linear-Flow valves, a Therma-Cast aluminum cookbox, a cabinet base and blue LED knobs finish the matte black build.

excerpt: Pellet-ready four-burner gas grill at 40,000 BTU, with an infrared side burner, a rotisserie kit and an optional Pellet Core module.
description:
This one ships as a gas grill and leaves the door open. Adding the Pellet Core module, which is optional, converts the same cookbox to gas and pellet running, and the searing burner alongside, infrared and rated separately, makes a reverse sear a one-grill job.
Four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 2,865 sq cm that reaches 4,155 sq cm with the rack. Heavy-duty grids hold heat for clear marks, the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield keeps fat off the tubes, and a rear rotisserie burner comes with its kit. Sensi-Touch Linear-Flow valves sit behind blue LED knobs on a matte black panel.

excerpt: Matte black four-burner at 40,000 BTU, with a side burner plus a rear burner of 15,000 BTU that drives the spit kit supplied.
description:
The four-burner Baron in a head-to-toe matte black finish, with the same working parts as the standard version.
Burner output comes to 40,000 BTU from four stainless Dual-Tube burners, beneath a main grate of 2,865 sq cm that reaches 4,155 sq cm once the rack is counted. Cast iron grids reverse from a searing face to a grooved basting face, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield stops fat short of the tubes, a side burner at 10,000 BTU takes pans, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU runs the rotisserie supplied. Sure-Lite ignition and Linear-Flow valves handle lighting.

excerpt: Five-burner built-in grill for island installation, rated at 45,000 BTU over a 3,677 sq cm grate, with reversible cast iron grids.
description:
Five burners and no cart: this chassis is designed to sit flush in an island or a run of outdoor cabinetry, with the controls along the front.
Five Dual-Tube burners in stainless steel rate 45,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 3,677 sq cm, which is surface enough to cook for a gathering in one pass. Cast iron grids reverse between narrow searing bars and a grooved basting face, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield catches fat above the tubes, and Sure-Lite electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves handle lighting and adjustment.

excerpt: Matte black built-in on five Dual-Tube burners, rated at 45,000 BTU with a 3,677 sq cm grate for larger outdoor kitchens.
description:
The drop-in 520 finished in matte black, made to sit flush with the counter and to read as part of dark stone or timber cabinetry rather than as a separate appliance.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together over a main grate of 3,677 sq cm. Reversible cast iron grids switch between searing bars and a grooved face that holds juices under the food, the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield keeps fat off the tubes, and Sure-Lite electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves manage lighting and heat.

excerpt: Matte black built-in on five burners at 45,000 BTU, with a rear infrared burner for spit-roasting birds and joints.
description:
Five burners plus a rear infrared burner in a drop-in chassis, finished matte black for a counter cut-out. The rear burner exists for spit work, turning chickens and joints in front of radiant heat rather than above the main grate.
The five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 3,677 sq cm. Cast iron grids reverse between a searing face and a basting face, and a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield takes the fat before it can reach the tubes.

excerpt: Pellet-ready five-burner at 45,000 BTU, with 8 mm stainless grids, an infrared side burner and a rotisserie kit, in matte black.
description:
A five-burner gas grill that can be converted later. The Pellet Core module, which is optional, lets the same cookbox burn wood for slow smoking, and with a 10,000 BTU searing burner of the infrared type alongside, both halves of a reverse sear are covered.
Output comes to 45,000 BTU from five stainless Dual-Tube burners, over a main grate of 3,677 sq cm that reaches 5,032 sq cm with the stainless rack. The 8 mm stainless rods hold heat through a heavy load, full-coverage Flav-R-Wave panels intercept fat, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU drives the rotisserie supplied. Sensi-Touch Linear-Flow valves and blue LED knobs sit on the matte black panel.

excerpt: Matte black five-burner cart grill at 45,000 BTU, with a side burner, a rear rotisserie burner and 5,032 sq cm of grate in total.
description:
A five-burner cart in matte black, sized for households that grill mid-week and still have grate space left when the weekend brings more people.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together, beneath a main grate of 3,677 sq cm that reaches 5,032 sq cm with the rack. Cast iron grids reverse from searing bars to a grooved basting face, the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield stops fat short of the tubes, a side burner at 10,000 BTU takes pans off the main surface, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU runs the rotisserie supplied. Sure-Lite ignition and Linear-Flow valves set the heat.

excerpt: Stainless four-burner rated at 40,000 BTU, carrying a side burner of the infrared type for hard searing, plus a rear spit burner and kit.
description:
Stainless bodywork and two specialist burners set this four-burner apart from the base carts. The infrared side burner runs hot enough to crust a steak, and the rear burner drives the rotisserie kit that comes with it.
Four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together, with cooking space of 4,155 sq cm once the warming rack is counted. Cast iron grids reverse between a searing face and a grooved basting face, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield catches fat above the tubes, and Sure-Lite electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves handle lighting and heat.

excerpt: Stainless five-burner at 45,000 BTU with an infrared searing burner, a rear rotisserie burner and kit, and a 3,677 sq cm grate.
description:
The five-burner member of the stainless Baron IR line, with a side burner of the infrared type for fierce searing and a rear burner for the rotisserie kit included with it.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together, over a main grate of 3,677 sq cm that reaches 5,032 sq cm with the stainless rack in place. Cast iron grids turn over between searing bars and a grooved basting face, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield keeps fat off the tubes, and Sure-Lite electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves manage lighting and adjustment.

excerpt: Four-burner cart grill rated at 40,000 BTU, with cast iron grates that reverse, a side shelf and a closed cart that hides the tank.
description:
An entry point into the Broil King line that keeps the parts that matter: four stainless Dual-Tube burners rated at 40,000 BTU, cast iron grids that turn over, and a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield sitting above the tubes.
The grid faces differ: narrow searing bars and a grooved face that keeps juices under the food. Electronic ignition and Linear-Flow valves make lighting and adjustment simple, while the enclosed cart keeps the tank out of sight and carries a side shelf for platters and tools.

excerpt: Matte black four-burner at 40,000 BTU over a 2,968 sq cm grate, with a side burner of 10,000 BTU built into the shelf.
description:
Matte black panels over a straightforward four-burner layout, built for patio use through the season rather than for the occasional weekend.
Four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together under a main grate of 2,968 sq cm, which holds a full tray of burgers with a cooler corner left over. Cast iron grids reverse between a searing face and a basting face, the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield takes fat before it reaches the tubes, and a built-in side burner of 10,000 BTU keeps pans off the main surface.

excerpt: Four-burner Crown-series grill rated at 40,000 BTU, with a 2,865 sq cm main grate and a side burner of 10,000 BTU.
description:
Four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together under a main grate of 2,865 sq cm, with a built-in side burner of 10,000 BTU alongside for onions, sauces and anything that belongs in a pan.
Cast iron grids turn over between narrow searing bars and a grooved face that holds juices under the food. Fat from the grate lands on a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield instead of the tubes, which keeps flare-ups down, and electronic ignition with Linear-Flow valves keeps lighting and heat control simple.

excerpt: Matte black four-burner with a 2,865 sq cm main grate, 40,000 BTU of burner output and a side burner alongside.
description:
The Crown four-burner in an all-black finish, sized for weeknight cooking without running short when more people turn up.
Its four stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 40,000 BTU together over a main grate of 2,865 sq cm, and a built-in side burner of 10,000 BTU adds a place for pans. Cast iron grids reverse from searing bars to a grooved basting face, and the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield converts fat to smoke before it can reach the tubes.

excerpt: Matte black five-burner at 45,000 BTU, with a 3,677 sq cm main grate and a built-in side burner for pan work.
description:
Five burners in an all-black body, for cooks who regularly fill the grate rather than use a corner of it.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together under a main grate of 3,677 sq cm, enough to keep separate hot and holding zones going through a long session. A built-in side burner of 10,000 BTU takes pans, cast iron grids reverse between searing and basting faces, and a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield intercepts fat above the tubes.

excerpt: Matte black five-burner rated at 45,000 BTU, with a large main grate, cast iron grids and a side burner of 10,000 BTU.
description:
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 45,000 BTU together on this model, spread over a large main grate that suits a crowd as readily as a weeknight dinner. The finish is matte black across lid, cart and control panel.
Cast iron grids reverse between narrow searing bars and a grooved basting face, and the stainless Flav-R-Wave shield stops fat short of the tubes, so flare-ups stay down. A built-in side burner of 10,000 BTU provides a second surface for sauces and sides.

excerpt: Pellet grill and smoker with app control over WiFi or Bluetooth, an 18 lb hopper, cast iron grates and a 2,871 sq cm grate.
description:
A wood-pellet grill and smoker whose digital controller holds a set temperature and reports over WiFi or Bluetooth, so a long cook can be followed from indoors. Its 18 lb hopper carries enough fuel for extended sessions between refills.
The body is built from 1.5 mm steel. The main grate measures 2,871 sq cm, or 4,129 sq cm in total once the rack is in use, with cast iron grids over the fire. Temperature range runs from smoking heat at the bottom end up to searing heat at the top, and the same chamber will roast and bake.

excerpt: Larger Crown Pellet model with a 3,613 sq cm main grate, an 18 lb hopper and temperature control from a phone.
description:
The larger of the two Crown Pellet models, with a main grate of 3,613 sq cm that comes to 5,161 sq cm in total once the rack is counted.
Cast iron grids sit over a body of 1.5 mm steel, and the 18 lb hopper keeps fuel moving through long cooks. A digital controller with WiFi and Bluetooth holds the target temperature and can be adjusted from a phone, over a range that starts at smoking heat and climbs to searing heat. Roasting and baking happen in the same chamber.

excerpt: Compact three-burner in matte black, 8.8 kW over a 1,900 sq cm grate, with cast iron grids and side shelves that fold away.
description:
A small-footprint three-burner for balconies, courtyards and patios where a full-size cart will not fit.
Its three burners deliver 8.8 kW over a main grate of 1,900 sq cm, or 2,775 sq cm once the rack above is counted. Cast iron grids hold heat well enough for clear marks, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield keeps fat off the tubes, the side shelves fold down when space is tight, and lighting is by electronic ignition. The finish is matte black throughout.

excerpt: Six-burner flagship with two independent ovens, 60,000 BTU, grids of cast stainless, a searing burner of the infrared type, rotisserie kit supplied.
description:
Two independent ovens sit side by side under one lid line, so a roast can hold at one temperature while a steak sears at another, or a finished batch can stay warm while the next one goes on.
Six stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 60,000 BTU in total, with 6,645 sq cm of cooking area over grids in professional cast stainless steel. A side burner of the infrared type covers fierce searing, a rear burner of 15,000 BTU turns the rotisserie supplied, a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield intercepts fat above the tubes, and the control knobs are illuminated.

excerpt: Built-in five-burner rated at 55,000 BTU, with iQue temperature control by WiFi or Bluetooth, a side burner, rotisserie kit supplied.
description:
The built-in Imperial QS pairs a five-burner cookbox with iQue control, which watches the set temperature and adjusts to hold it, reporting to a phone by WiFi or Bluetooth. The chassis is made to sit flush in an island or a cabinetry run.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 55,000 BTU together, over a main grate of 4,032 sq cm that reaches 5,645 sq cm with the rack. Grids in professional cast stainless steel sit above a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield, a side burner of 13,000 BTU handles pans, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU drives the rotisserie supplied.

excerpt: Cart-mounted five-burner rated at 55,000 BTU, with self-regulating iQue control, a side burner of 13,000 BTU, a spit kit and grids of cast stainless.
description:
iQue control does the watching on this cart model. The grill tracks its own temperature and trims the burners to hold it, whether the target is smoking heat, roasting heat or full rotisserie heat, and it reports to a phone by WiFi or Bluetooth.
Five stainless Dual-Tube burners rate 55,000 BTU together, over a main grate of 4,032 sq cm that reaches 5,645 sq cm with the rack. Grids in professional cast stainless steel run above a stainless Flav-R-Wave shield, a side burner of 13,000 BTU takes pans and sauces, and a rear burner of 15,000 BTU turns the rotisserie supplied.

excerpt: A 6,000 lb low-rise lift with 110V electric/hydraulic power, multi-position locks, and a dropped crossbar for undercar clearance.
description:
Low-rise lifting for wheel service, brake jobs, and general maintenance, rated at 6,000 lb so light trucks, SUVs, and passenger cars are all in range. The electric/hydraulic power unit runs on 110V, and multi-position safety locks hold the load at whatever working height the job calls for.
The steel channel frame measures 83 inches long by 74 inches wide, collapses to 4 inches, and raises to a maximum of 23.5 inches. A dropped crossbar opens up clearance underneath, and rubber lifting blocks are included to protect frame contact points.

excerpt: An open-center mid-rise scissor lift rated at 6,000 lb, with a pivoting kicker for extra force off the floor and push-button lock release.
description:
Mid-rise scissor lifting with an open center, so the underside of the vehicle stays reachable while it is in the air. Capacity is 6,000 lb, and the lift points sit far enough apart that longer-wheelbase cars and light trucks rest safely on the platforms.
A pivoting kicker adds force through the first six inches of travel, which matters when a low car starts from a fully collapsed lift. Four steel scissor bars carry the load, solid-steel lock bars engage on the way up, and a push button releases them for descent. The approach ramps come off for a flush-mount setup.

excerpt: A 10,000 lb two-post baseplate lift for bays with 11-foot ceilings, packed with a twelve-piece set of truck adapters.
description:
The baseplate layout keeps the crossbar at floor level, so this two-post lift fits a bay whose ceiling stops at 11 feet. The 10,000 lb rating covers everything from compact cars up to a one-ton dually.
Oversized columns carry middle welded support gussets for rigidity, and the two chain-drive hydraulic cylinders are built to ANSI safety standards. The arms are super-symmetric, the lock release works from a single point, and a twelve-piece truck adapter set is packed with the lift. The finish is powder coat.

excerpt: A 1.5 HP rim-clamp tire changer paired with an electronic balancer, covering rims from 12 to 28 inches on 110V power.
description:
Two machines that cover the whole tire job. The 806B changer clamps rims from 14 to 26 inches on the inside and 12 to 28 inches on the outside, takes wheels up to 46 inches in diameter, and breaks beads with 2,500 kgf of force at 8 to 10 bar. It runs on 110V and has an air bead blaster for seating stubborn beads.
Steel cast clamping jaws with protective sleeves grip without marking the rim, and a motorcycle adapter is available as an option. The 70D balancer runs automatic static and dynamic programs plus an ALU mode, with internal and external data set arms for entering wheel measurements.

excerpt: The 806B changer and 70D balancer together, with a 2,500 kgf bead breaker, ALU balancing modes, and standard 110V power.
description:
Tire work in a home garage or a small shop needs both halves of the job covered, and this pair does it. The 806B changer takes rims from 12 to 28 inches clamped from the outside, or 14 to 26 inches from the inside, up to a 46-inch wheel and a 14-inch tire width.
Its bead breaker delivers 2,500 kgf at an operating pressure of 8 to 10 bar, backed by an air bead blaster and a high-density aluminum piston, and the machine weighs 536 lbs. Power is 110V. The 70D balancer handles static, dynamic, and ALU programs, with data set arms for internal and external measurements.

excerpt: An air-powered end lift for trucks, buses, and farm equipment, with six automatic lock positions and a 12.5 to 50 inch range.
description:
Air-powered lifting for the whole front or rear of a truck, bus, or piece of farm equipment, the kind of job a floor jack is not built for. A three-way air valve governs the rate of rise and descent, and an automatic safety lock catches at six height positions regardless of air pressure.
The saddles adjust and extend, with 14.75 inches of saddle reach, and travel runs from 12.5 inches collapsed to 50 inches raised. A swivel caster at the front and two 12-1/4 inch pneumatic rear tires move the unit across a shop floor. Overall it stands 65.75 inches tall on a 40.5 by 35.5 inch base.

excerpt: A CE-certified two-post lift with Q355/A572 steel carriages, automatic arm restraints, and double-point safety lock release.
description:
A two-post lift carrying CE certification on both the structure and the hydraulic system, third-party tested to 115 percent of rated load dynamically and 150 percent statically. The carriages are built from Q355/A572 steel rather than the more common Q235.
Operation is straightforward, with a button to raise the vehicle and a manual lever to lower it. A double-point lock release, automatic arm restraints, an up-limit switch, and a built-in relief valve cover the main failure points, while double seal rings protect the polyurethane and door guard rubber keeps panels off the columns.

excerpt: A 10,000 lb low-rise lift that collapses to 4.5 inches, with dual hydraulic cylinders and eight rubber-topped adapters.
description:
Low-rise lifting at a 10,000 lb rating, which brings trucks, SUVs, and heavier vehicles into range of a lift style usually reserved for cars. It collapses to 4.5 inches for a low approach and raises to 22.75 inches, enough for wheel, brake, and undercar work.
Four parallelogram frame support bars and dual hydraulic cylinders carry the load, and the full-length platform is rubber topped. Eight multi-height rubber adapters, drive-over ramps, side rails, and built-in trays for lug nuts and small parts are part of the package. The power unit runs on 208-240V.

excerpt: A portable 7,000 lb two-post lift that sets up or stows in under 15 minutes and runs from a standard 110V outlet.
description:
A two-post lift that does not have to stay bolted in place. Hydraulic couplers that snap together, plus anchors that drop into the floor, let the columns go up or come down in under 15 minutes, so a garage can become a work bay and then go back to being a garage.
Capacity is 7,000 lb, enough for sedans through light trucks, and the arms sit low enough to reach under lowered cars. Lift height runs from 4.75 to 45.5 inches, leaving the underside clear. Built-in wheels handle moving it, the slide blocks need no maintenance, and the power unit plugs into a standard 110V household outlet.

excerpt: A commercial-grade 12,000 lb two-post lift with extra-wide spacing, symmetric arms, and selectable 165 or 177 inch height.
description:
Extra-tall, extra-wide column spacing is the point here, so vans, box trucks, long-wheelbase pickups, and ordinary passenger cars all fit between the posts. The rating is 12,000 lb, and overall height can be set at 165 inches or 177 inches, with a 150-inch configuration possible when additional cables are used.
Symmetric arms and dual direct-drive cylinders handle the lift, with automatic arm restraints, a single-point lock release, and a padded shut-off bar that stops travel if a roof makes contact. Carriage door guards protect panels, the finish is powder coat, and a 12-piece truck adapter set is included.

excerpt: A 12,000 lb open-top baseplate lift standing 122.5 inches tall, with three-stage symmetric arms and two width settings.
description:
The baseplate layout runs the hydraulics and cables across the floor instead of overhead, which brings overall height down to 122.5 inches. That suits a shop with a low ceiling that still needs to put trucks, vans, and commercial vehicles in the air at a 12,000 lb rating.
Oversized columns can be installed at either of two widths depending on what gets serviced. Three-stage symmetric arms reach a range of wheelbases, automatic restraints hold them in position, and a single-point release drops the locks from one spot. Dual hydraulic chain-over cylinders drive the carriages, which carry rubber guards.

excerpt: An air-powered hydraulic jack for trucks and heavy equipment, lifting from 18.125 to 51.375 inches with an 8-foot remote hose.
description:
Single-point air-powered lifting for trucks, farm machinery, construction equipment, and buses, usable alone or in pairs when a job needs two contact points. A three-way air valve controls rise and descent, and extension tubes with detent pins set the working height.
Travel runs from 18.125 inches to 51.375 inches on an 11.25-inch stroke, and the saddle has locating lugs to keep the load seated. A removable handle and an 8-foot air hose allow operation from a step back, while two 8-inch rubber tread wheels move the jack into crowded spots.

excerpt: A 2.0 HP semi-automatic tire changer paired with an electronic balancer that handles rims up to 24 inches and wheels to 155 lbs.
description:
The 580 changer runs a 2.0 HP motor and clamps rims from 10 to 18 inches externally or 12 to 20 inches internally, taking tires up to 37 inches in diameter and 12 inches wide. Bead breaking comes from a pneumatic piston rated at 5,600 lbs, with an operating pressure of 120 to 145 psi and 110V power only.
It arrives with a steel mount head and four clamp protectors, and the bird head carries a protector of its own. The 690 balancer is preconfigured to American standards and covers rim diameters of 10 to 24 inches and widths of 1.5 to 20 inches, up to a 44-inch wheel weighing as much as 155 lbs.

excerpt: Tire changer and wheel balancer sold as a pair, joining a 2.0 HP clamping machine with a 44-inch-capacity electronic balancer.
description:
A shop that mounts and balances tires all day needs both machines, and the 580 and 690 divide the work between them. The changer pairs a 2.0 HP motor with a dual turntable foot pedal and clamps rims from 12 to 20 inches inside, or 10 to 18 inches outside, with a 5,600 lbs pneumatic bead breaker behind it.
Maximum tire diameter is 37 inches at a 12-inch width, air supply is 120 to 145 psi, and power is 110V only. Motorcycle work is possible with optional adapter kits. The 690 balancer accepts wheels up to 44 inches in diameter and 155 lbs in weight, across rim widths of 1.5 to 20 inches.

excerpt: A 3,800 lb zero-tail-swing mini excavator with a Tier 4 Kubota D902 and dual-pump hydraulics for running two attachments at once.
description:
A mini excavator at 3,800 lbs operating weight, built around a Kubota D902 diesel that is EPA certified to Tier 4. The dual-pump hydraulic system with a double throttle valve lets two attachments run at the same time, a thumb and an auger for instance, without one starving the other.
The zero tail swing profile passes through standard doorways and fits in elevators, which is what makes the machine usable on indoor jobs and tight urban lots. A 400mm bucket suits trenching between orchard and vineyard rows, and a hydraulic thumb clip is included for handling trees, boulders, and irrigation lines.

excerpt: A compact electric forklift rated at 4,400 lbs that raises its forks 1,400mm before the mast extends, built for low-ceiling aisles.
description:
An electric forklift sized for indoor work under a low ceiling. The forks rise 1,400mm before the mast begins to extend, and the three-stage mast then steps through 1,600mm, 3,000mm, and 4,500mm. Rated lift is 4,400 lbs at a 500mm load center.
The truck weighs 6,170 lbs and measures 2,600mm long excluding the forks by 1,230mm wide, on a 1,740mm wheelbase, turning inside a 2,310mm radius with lateral movement for narrow aisles. A 60V/250Ah lead acid battery charges in six hours from any 110V point and runs up to ten, and a charger comes with it. Steering is hydraulic, tires are solid rubber.

excerpt: A 2,500 kg electric forklift with a 2,350mm turning radius that raises its forks 1,400mm before the mast has to extend.
description:
Rated at 5,511 lbs, or 2,500 kg, with 1,400mm of fork travel available before the mast starts to extend, which keeps the truck working under a seven-foot ceiling. The triple-stage mast then reaches 1.6m, 3.0m, and 4.5m for racking at different levels.
The truck measures 2,700mm long by 1,200mm wide and turns within a 2,350mm radius, with lateral movement for narrow aisles and mezzanine work. Power comes from a 60V/250Ah lead acid battery that charges in six hours on a standard 110V outlet and returns more than ten hours of running. Solid rubber tires suit warehouse and plant floors.

excerpt: A 3,000 kg electric forklift on a 7,500 lb chassis, with triple-stage lift to 4.5m and a 60V battery that charges on 110V.
description:
The largest of the Vigor electric trucks, rated at 6,600 lbs on a 7,500 lb chassis. Its forks travel 1,400mm before the mast starts to extend, which keeps it usable under seven-foot ceilings, and the triple-stage mast reaches 1.6m, 3.0m, and 4.5m where headroom allows.
Turning radius is 2,530mm, and lateral movement helps in narrow-aisle racking and on mezzanines. The 60V/250Ah lead acid battery takes six hours to charge from a standard 110V outlet and returns more than ten hours of work. Solid rubber tires handle concrete without maintenance.

excerpt: A self-propelled 21.5 inch cordless mower on two 20V MAX batteries, bundled with a string trimmer, blower, and hedge trimmer.
description:
The mower draws on two 20V MAX 10 Ah batteries for 400 watt hours combined, driving a brushless direct-drive motor under a 21.5 inch steel deck, with runtime reaching 50 minutes. Auto Sensing raises torque in heavy growth, six deck heights span 1.5 to 4.0 inches, and clippings can be mulched, bagged, or discharged to the side on lots up to half an acre.
Drive speed adjusts to match walking pace. Alongside the mower, the 14 inch string trimmer folds down 41 percent of its length for storage, and the handheld blower moves up to 450 cubic feet per minute at 125 mph with the concentrator fitted, measuring 66 dB in operation.
